items.title: Three assumptions we unlearned about participatory grantmaking
items.summary: NEO Philanthropy describes lessons from a national participatory grantmaking pilot for the research and data initiative of the Economic Mobility and Opportunity Fund. The pilot involved an advisory committee of people with lived experience and aimed to shift decision-making power.

items.title: Americares $50M Donation To Fund Programs, Fund Endowment
items.summary: Americares received a $50 million gift, the largest donation in its history. The gift will support global health programs and its endowment, toward a goal of reaching 100 million people with health care by 2030.

items.title: Pooling for Power (Blog)
items.summary: Undue Medical Debt, formerly RIP Medical Debt, was founded in 2014 to buy medical debt in bulk for pennies on the dollar and erase it, funded by small-dollar donors. The piece describes the model as one in which $1 can erase $100 of medical debt.

items.title: How 3 leaders donated $20 million from Melinda French Gates
items.summary: Melinda French Gates gave $20 million each to 12 leaders through Pivotal's $240 million Global Leaders program, with no requirements beyond spending by end of 2026. Pivotal calls it a huge success and is looking to replicate it.

items.title: In a big bet on democracy, some major funders are going local
items.summary: Five major funders, including Ford, Hewlett, and MacArthur, announced a $26 million initiative with three-year grants of $500,000 to $1 million for local community bridge-building efforts. Lever for Change will manage the open call.

items.title: Update: DonorPerfect, GoFundMe Pro face cyberattacks
items.summary: DonorPerfect and GoFundMe Pro experienced cyberattacks. GoFundMe Pro donor data was compromised, and DonorPerfect's more than 11,000 customers lost access to donor data from November 10. As of November 16, 99 percent of systems had been restored, according to company president Lauren Sheehan.

items.title: If Bernie Marcus Came Back for One More Lunch
items.summary: The Marcus Foundation, founded by Home Depot co-founder Bernie Marcus, will spend down over roughly two decades following his death in November 2024. Foundation President Jay Kaiman reflects on the work as the foundation prepares to sunset over the next 18 years.
